method: Opened each of five unmodified extracted PNGs with view_image; independently reread their original bytes and compared SHA256 and byte counts with the source-bound Flutter agent manifest.
observations: fold-cover-start.png: Belohnungen label is fully visible; Lernen, Spielen and Tests labels are readable; the compact Lumo Kart promotional title and subtitle remain visibly ellipsized.

fold-cover-learning-cards.png and phone-learning-cards.png: opened subject cards display readable titles, descriptions and progress counters; viewport edges intersect subsequent cards, so the captures do not show the entire scrollable list simultaneously.
fold-open-learning-cards.png: all eleven subject cards and their progress regions are completely visible within the reviewed image.
large-text-learning-cards.png: Mathe, Deutsch, Lesen and Schreiben titles, subtitles and progress text are readable without internal glyph clipping in the reviewed region.
No yellow-black overflow stripe or unreadable title was observed. Decorative light stars overlap a few subtitle glyphs; those words remain readable in these original images.
limits: Visual review of the stated five Flutter captures only; no Android/runtime acceptance implied.
No new screenshot, image transformation or duplicate archive download.
Hit testing and tap behavior are covered by the original test artifacts, not inferred from pixel inspection.
